dependencyReasons.semantic-correctness: PRODUCES/CONSUMES. The shadow run's completion verdict is produced by the hardened completion evaluator: it consumes completion-contract-enforcement, attempt-bound-disposition and blocking-escalation-semantics. Running it against the unhardened evaluator would prove the old contract, which is the thing this session replaced.
dependencyReasons.evidence-durability: PRODUCES/CONSUMES. Shadow artifacts enter the durable-evidence-store this stream produces; the run cannot demonstrate that artifacts survive a fresh process against a store that does not yet exist.
dependencyReasons.durable-state-runtime: PRODUCES/CONSUMES. The run's WorkItem, RouteTasks and Attempts are persisted through control-plane-repositories and claimed through lease-coordinator. There is no durable shadow run without the repository layer it consumes.
dependencyReasons.method-runtime: PRODUCES/CONSUMES. The inherited route floor is computed from the canonical method projection, and any route discovered during the run is fed through method-candidate-lifecycle rather than mutating canonical knowledge directly.
